interpretation: The ISM is NOT at the phase-random null floor. Both V1 and V2 ISM have associator values well below the independent-phase surrogate level (0.55), meaning the ISM retains organized cross-channel phase coupling. V1's floor (0.017) is the lowest observed value anywhere -- lower than even quiet inner heliosphere. This suggests the ISM has a very high degree of phase organization: the interstellar magnetic field is the most coherently coupled environment measured. V2's higher floor (0.13) may reflect residual heliospheric contamination or a different ISM sector.
